digest.component_or_area: dependency link escalation / redirect reporting across CLI, library, and MCP callers
propositions: A cross-subtree blocking link is silently escalated to a different edge and the library/MCP caller is told only 'ok', so the caller believes the requested edge was recorded when it was not.
The redirect record is emitted only to stdout via _emit_redirect and is never returned, and the quiet=True sink discards that stdout for in-process callers.
The MCP link_tickets tool calls rebar.link and returns the literal 'ok' with no indication that different endpoints were recorded.
The propagation chain drops the redirect value at three points: the _link closure, _python_leaf (annotated -> None), and rebar.link itself.
The fix returns the redirect record up the chain while leaving quiet=True intact, because unsuppressed stdout would corrupt the MCP-over-stdio JSON-RPC stream.
link_tickets should keep returning exactly 'ok' with no escalation and a fixed template naming requested and resolved endpoints when escalation occurs, preserving its str return type.
